title: Manufacturing Execution System Outage Response
description: Manufacturing Execution System outages affecting production operations
triggers: Complete MES outage affecting production lines
immediate_actions: Assess impact on production operations and manufacturing processes
Implement manual production procedures if needed
Contact plant management for production impact assessment
investigation_steps: Review MES application logs and status
Verify network connectivity to production lines
resolution_steps: Restart MES services following standard procedures
Implement database fixes or restart if needed
Apply MES patches or configuration changes
Coordinate with MES vendor for complex issues
verification: Test MES functionality at affected production lines
Confirm with plant staff that system is operational
special_considerations: Production line stopped due to supported IT infrastructure failure is P1
Coordinate all plant network changes with the local OT engineer
Maintain operational safety during system restoration
